HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: Nobody at the camp has slept properly in a week because one Heathen has started snoring.

description_variants.description: Nobody at the camp has slept properly in a week because one Isolan has started snoring.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: Nobody at the camp has slept properly in a week because (subject) has started snoring like a landslide. (friend), who shares (subject.his/her) hut, has tried everything: rolling (subject.him/her) over, a pillow over (friend.his/her) own head, singing lullabies. Finally (friend) moves (friend.his/her) mat outside. It turns out to be a lovely place to sleep.
